part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Laughing
questions: What kinds of thing make you laugh?
Do you like making other people laugh? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think it's important for people to laugh? [Why/Why not?]
Is laughing the same as feeling happy, do you think? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe an idea you had for improving something at work or college.
points: when and where you had your idea
who you told about your idea
part2.closing: and explain why you thought your idea would make an improvement.

topics.title: Ideas and education
questions: Some people think that education should be about memorising the important ideas of the past. Do you agree or disagree? Why?
Should education encourage students to have their own new ideas? Why?
How do you think teachers could help students to develop and share their own ideas?

topics.title: Ideas in the workplace
questions: Should employers encourage their workers to have new ideas about improving the company? Why?
Do you think people sometimes dislike ideas just because they are new? Why?
What is more difficult: having new ideas or putting them into practice? Which is more important for a successful company?
